title: Three-electrode cell lid
blurb: For the electrochemistry side of my own research. The uncompensated resistance is whatever sits between the working electrode and the reference tip, so a cell clamped by hand has a different one every setup and two runs a week apart are not comparable. Drawing it found a conflict worth keeping: a 6 mm reference cannot sit 5 mm from a 6 mm working electrode, the holes merge. That is what a Luggin capillary is for.
